ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black/charcoal) pixels comprise approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels appearing as sparse mottling and localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white speckling and small geometric blobs are distributed semi-randomly across both lobes, with a higher concentration of white pixels observed along the trailing edges and near the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 45-degree angle of divergence at the point of intersection between the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are present along the entire trailing edge; the left lobe displays three distinct irregular notches (valleys) approximately 2/3 of the way toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a sigmoidal curve, exhibiting slight convexity near the median notch and transitioning to concavity as it approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small, roughly circular white pixel clusters (2-5 pixels in diameter) are visible, particularly on the left lobe, indicating previous attachment sites or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) are visible; three roughly parallel vertical lines on the right lobe and several intersecting diagonal lines on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of brown/orange-tinted barnacles are attached to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, creating a jagged, non-biological edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-contrast white linear scar on the lower-left lobe, oriented roughly parallel to the trailing edge.
